_comment: EDIT THIS FILE to tune CTaDI onboarding. Nothing else needs to change: weights, threshold, the ideal-member profile the LLM scores against, and every applicant-facing message live here.

do_not_score_on: length of answer as a proxy for effort

criteria_guidance.values_alignment: Alignment with sustainability, equity, and people-centred (not purely extractive or purely technological) development. Do they treat technology as a means, and people as the end?
criteria_guidance.relevant_skill_level: Demonstrated competence in the role they applied for: tools named, methods understood, and a self-rating that matches the concrete example given. Calibrate against the role's stated expectations, not against a PhD.
criteria_guidance.quality_of_thinking: Depth and coherence on education and on 'where development should begin'. Do they reason, give reasons, acknowledge trade-offs, or just assert slogans? Reward original, specific thinking over buzzwords.
criteria_guidance.evidence_of_real_work: Concrete, verifiable-sounding work: a named project, a specific problem they solved, a measurable result, a link or artefact. Reward what they have actually done over what they intend to do.
criteria_guidance.commitment_and_availability: Realistic, specific availability: hours per week, duration, and how they fit alongside other obligations. A modest but honest commitment beats a vague grand one.

ideal_member_profile._comment: Plain-language description of the member you want. This is injected verbatim into the scoring prompt. Edit freely; keep it concrete.
ideal_member_profile.summary: A member who believes sustainable technology should serve people and ecosystems rather than replace them; who thinks carefully about education as a foundation for capability; who can point to real work they have done; and who can commit a realistic amount of time to the community.
what_we_value: Treats development as improving people's real capabilities and choices, not just raising GDP or deploying gadgets.
Believes change must begin with the people and context affected, with local knowledge and consent, rather than being designed elsewhere and delivered downwards.
Understands education as building the ability to reason, question and act — not merely as credentialing or information transfer.
Wants to contribute something specific to CTaDI, not merely to gain access to a network.
Has done real work in their field and can describe it concretely, including what went wrong.
Gives an honest, bounded commitment rather than an aspirational unlimited one.
what_we_are_not_looking_for: Slogans or recycled definitions with no reasoning behind them.
Purely technology-first answers that treat people as passive recipients of solutions.
Self-rated expertise with no concrete example, or examples that contradict the rating.
Motivation that is only about personal benefit, prestige, or job-seeking with no contribution.
Answers that are clearly written to satisfy a rubric rather than to answer the question.

messages.applicant_received: Thank you — we have received your application. If you are shortlisted, you will hear from us soon. Either way, we appreciate the time you took.
messages.applicant_not_shortlisted: Thank you for taking the time to apply to CTaDI. We have read your application carefully. On this occasion we are not taking it forward, but we would be glad to hear from you again in a future round. We wish you well with your work.
messages.applicant_shortlisted: Thank you — your application has been shortlisted for review by the CTaDI membership team. We will be in touch shortly with next steps.
messages.applicant_approved: Welcome to CTaDI. Your application has been approved. Your community invitation link is below — it is personal to you, please do not share it publicly.
messages.applicant_rejected: Thank you again for applying to CTaDI. After review we are not able to offer you membership in this round. We are grateful for your interest and hope our paths cross again.
messages.decision_already_made: This application has already been reviewed and a decision has been recorded.
messages.link_expired: This review link has expired or is invalid. Please open the admin dashboard to review this application.
